input.quote: 4.1 License Fees. In consideration for the licenses granted to Corio pursuant to Section 2 of this Agreement, Corio shall pay the license fees specified in EXHIBIT B hereto. Payment terms of such license fees shall be as set forth in EXHIBIT B hereto.
input.rationale: No most-favoured-nation or price/terms-matching obligation exists anywhere in the Agreement. Fees (Section 4, Exhibit B pricing, revenue sharing and payment terms) are fixed figures negotiated between the parties, with no requirement that Corio (our party, as licensee/customer) extend to Commerce One any better pricing, revenue share or other terms granted to third parties, and no obligation to match third-party offers. Searches for "most favored/favourable", "no less favorable", "lowest", "best price", "comparable", "similarly situated", "discount" and "any other customer" returned nothing, and the grant, marketing (Exhibit D) and shared-resources provisions contain no MFN mechanic. This sits at the playbook's preferred position (no MFN burdening the Customer), so no redline is warranted.
